description: This file defines a C# interface for a grain in an Orleans project, specifying methods for initialization and a blast call to create new grains.

classes.name: ICatalogTestGrain
classes.description: Interface for a grain with an integer key that supports initialization and bulk grain creation methods.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Asynchronous method to initialize the grain.

methods.name: BlastCallNewGrains
methods.description: Asynchronous method to perform a specified number of calls to create new grains, starting from a given key.
